task.text: For this part you are allowed 30misnutes to write an essay on whether violent video games online will cause students 'violent behaviors You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.

attempts.high: For this part you have 30 minutes to write a 120–180 word piece about video games and student behavior, but the angle is yours to invent. Pick whatever thesis, framing, and examples you find most compelling — defend it, complicate it, or take it somewhere unexpected. Your call on how to approach the whole thing, just keep it within 120 to 180 words.
attempts.low: For this part you have 30 minutes to write a 120–180 word essay on whether violent online video games cause violent behavior in students. Use exactly this structure: sentence 1 states your position, paragraph 1 gives reason one with one example, paragraph 2 gives reason two with one example, final sentence restates the position. Do not add other arguments or deviate from this template. Keep it between 120 and 180 words.
